items.title: 구찌와 머라이어 캐리가 완성한 눈부신 2026 홀리데이 풍경
items.summary: Vogue Korea covers Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey in Demna-directed looks, including an exclusive interview where Carey discusses her Christmas traditions and a private NY store event with a choir performance.

items.title: 박보검, '구찌' 글로벌 브랜드 앰버서더 발탁
items.summary: Actor Park Bo-gum was officially named Gucci's new global brand ambassador on Nov 5; he said he looks forward to understanding the style language Demna is building at Gucci and layering his own aesthetic onto it.

items.title: 닝닝, 전세계 반응 난리 난 파격 패션…과감한 노출 '힙해'
items.summary: Coverage of aespa's Ningning at the 15th LACMA Art+Film Gala in a custom Gucci look (feathered jacket, embroidered bra top), noted for drawing strong worldwide reaction to the bold styling.

items.title: 박보검·닝닝, LA 사로잡은 독보적 아우라… 제15회 구찌 LACMA 갈라 빛내다
items.summary: Park Bo-gum and Ningning attended the Gucci-sponsored 15th LACMA Art+Film Gala as global ambassadors, an event honoring artist Vija Celmins and director Denis Villeneuve; Gucci has partnered with LACMA since 2011.

items.title: グッチ、マライア・キャリーを起用した新たなホリデーキャンペーンを発表
items.summary: Japanese trade coverage of Gucci's new holiday campaign announcement featuring Mariah Carey, part of the brand's 2026 festive push under Demna.

items.title: グッチの新型バッグ「グッチ NY トートバッグ」が登場！ 伊勢丹新宿店で「GucciCore」ポップアップを開催
items.summary: A GucciCore pop-up ran at Isetan Shinjuku Nov 4-10, launching the new Gucci NY Tote Bag inspired by the brand's 70-year history in New York.

items.title: Gucci names Park Bo-gum global brand face
items.summary: Jing Daily's China-luxury intel notes Gucci's Park Bo-gum appointment alongside the brand's continuing China headwinds, citing Q3 2026 directly-operated store sales down 9% on weaker mainland traffic.

items.title: "명품보다 가성비" 중국 Z세대, 구찌 대신 코치 구매
items.summary: Critical-angle: Chinese Gen Z consumers are shifting from Gucci/Balenciaga to Coach and Ralph Lauren for value; Coach and Ralph Lauren China sales rose over 30% in Q3 while LVMH and Kering posted double-digit declines. A Shanghai consumer quoted saying luxury is no longer seen as a status symbol.

items.title: 올해 브랜드 가치 '나이키' 36%, '구찌' 31% 하락
items.summary: Critical-angle: per Interbrand's latest ranking, Gucci's brand value fell 30.7% to $8.1B, dropping 24 places to 93rd overall -- the steepest decline among luxury houses, following a 35% drop the prior year (roughly 55% cumulative loss over two years).

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？关店125家后业绩转正，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: A recurring templated Weibo explainer-style post on Gucci: frames ~40% of 2025's global net store closures as Gucci, with plans for at least 125 more in 2026 concentrated in Asia; covers Demna's La Famiglia debut and Kering's ReconKering recovery plan. No visible engagement counts; near-identical post titles recur across many dates/account IDs, suggesting templated/bulk content -- treated as low-confidence buzz signal per bot-filter guidance.

items.title: 박보검 구찌 오늘자 얼굴...jpg
items.summary: Korean community thread sharing photos of Park Bo-gum at the Gucci-sponsored LACMA Art+Film Gala; overwhelmingly positive/appreciative comments focused on his appearance. 35,220 views, 148 comments.

items.title: 역대 최악 실적 낸 구찌…경영 개선 기대감에 주가는 10% 쑥
items.summary: Critical-angle background (kept for context, outside 14-day window so excluded from freshness-weighted buzz): Gucci posted its worst-ever quarterly results (FY2025 sales -22%, Q4 -10%), yet Kering shares rose ~10% on hopes that the pace of decline was moderating.

items.title: 케링 프랑스 증시서 6.36% 상승 마감 191.70유로 기록
items.summary: Kering shares rose 6.36% to EUR191.70 on Euronext Paris on Nov 5 with no single confirmed disclosure identified as the catalyst; article flags continued investor caution pending Gucci-specific earnings clarity and notes recent volatility in the stock.

items.title: 朴宝剑亮相第15届LACMA艺术与电影盛典红毯
items.summary: Fan-topic Weibo post with red-carpet video of Park Bo-gum at the 15th LACMA Art+Film Gala, tagged to his role as Gucci global brand ambassador; associated clip shows 584 views, no like/comment/repost counts visible.
